newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares run out of steam, easier in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares run out of steam, easier in late trade.

text.p: Italian shares ended the week mostly easier, ignoring a record performance in London, after the market lost momentum in late afternoon when Wall Street dropped back from the highs.

The all-share Mibtel index closed 0.21 percent lower at 12,246 with the blue chip Mib30 finishing 0.34 percent lower at 18,252. Volume of 941 billion lire was swollen by heavy cross trades in ENI, Stet and Telecom stocks.
Fiat finished fractionally ahead at 5,718 lire but was well down on a high of 5,810 lire reached after the release of April cars data showing the group raising Italian market share.

Brokers reported a surge in activity in the last half hour as many operators squared their positions ahead of the weekend's mayoral elections in more than 1,000 municipalities across the country including the key northern cities of Turin and Milan.
Parmalat was up sharply, boosted by overseas orders and Mediaset also finished 0.97 percent ahead at 7,507 lire.
Among insurers, Alleanza, INA and RAS all finished lower although Generali closed 0.37 percent higher at 29,378 lire.
